fields.doubt: A regra de 2026-11-23 classifica a mineração de repositórios como 'Evaluates — repository mining', e aqui ela (RQ1–RQ3) ocupa a maior parte do artigo. Decide se a principal passa a essa, com o template como secundária.

fields.v: Instruction-file generation on AGIT-Instruct eval set (62 files), no coding agent; criterion: coverage of template categories and alignment with developer-written references. - GPT-4o-mini without template (exploratory): coverage 0.187 (Required 0.168, Gap 0.080, Recommended 0.500). - GPT-4o-mini zero-shot with template: coverage 0.828; full-file ROUGE-1 0.423, cos 0.681; overlap-only 0.386 / 0.710. - GPT-4o-mini RAG with template: coverage 0.786; ROUGE-1 0.459, cos 0.683; overlap 0.433 / 0.708; manual 278 instances: 19.4% match, 61.2% partial, 19.4% missing, 0 wrong. - CodeLlama-13B Base with template: coverage 0.645; ROUGE-1 0.304, cos 0.373; overlap 0.309 / 0.434. - CodeLlama-13B QLoRA with template: coverage 0.166 (Gap 0.044); ROUGE-1 0.273, cos 0.608; overlap 0.347 / 0.647. Quality verdict for all: no criterion stated by the authors. Cost verdict for all: not reported
fields.why: Rule 1: the quality verdicts (does not work / partly) rested on levels chosen by the extractor; the study sets no success threshold for coverage or alignment, so they are replaced by 'no criterion stated by the authors'. Configurations and values unchanged
